frame_row: Document-grounded proposal; no RTL hierarchy is asserted.

label: u_vlsit_riscv_debug_router
(m_vlsit_riscv_debug_router)
NEW
blocks.function: Routes external Debug Module requests to the selected active hart and returns per-hart debug state without embedding DTM/DM.

label: u_vlsit_riscv_cpu_tile_0.._3
(m_vlsit_riscv_cpu_tile)
NEW
blocks.function: Elaborates only indices 0 through PARA_CPU_NUM-1; each tile contains the licensed modified CVA6 integration shell and HPDcache coherence copy.

interfaces.name: External Debug Module connection
interfaces.active: External Debug Module -> router -> active harts
interfaces.signals: Per-hart request and mode/status semantics are specified at the cluster boundary; exact CVA6 native debug handshake must be pinned.

interfaces.name: Native per-hart debug connections
interfaces.signals: Each bit/lane maps to a zero-based hart; absent hart lanes are ignored in a two-hart build.

interfaces.name: Cluster clock/reset
interfaces.signals: All shown blocks use the selected cluster clock/reset; reset release is synchronized by the SoC.

legend_note: DTM and Debug Module remain outside the cluster. CVA6's debug interface is reused; the per-hart array routing wrapper is new VLSIT logic. Status codes: REUSE = upstream RTL reused; REUSE* = reuse candidate pending compatibility checks; MODIFY = source adaptation, wrapper, or macro binding; NEW = VLSIT RTL to design; GENERATED = CSR RTL from the selected generator. All proposed blocks are dashed because this cluster has no pinned integrated RTL yet.
